result.topic_en: Modular equations of various degrees n relating moduli k, l (with complements k', l') and multiplier M, in the style of Ramanujan's Russell-type and multiplier modular equations.
result.transcription:
Add. Ms a 94 18(92)  (92)
5. $n = 7$ or $\frac{5}{3}$. $\sqrt{\left(\frac{1+kl+k'l'}{2}\right)} = (kl)^{\frac14} + (k'l')^{\frac14} - (klk'l')^{\frac14}$.
$n = 15$. $\sqrt{\left(\frac{1+kl+k'l'}{2}\right)} = (kl)^{\frac14} + (k'l')^{\frac14} + (klk'l')^{\frac14}$.
$n = 23$. $\sqrt{\left(\frac{1+kl+k'l'}{2}\right)} = \frac12\left\{1 + \sqrt{(kl)} + \sqrt{(k'l')}\right\} + (4klk'l')^{\frac13}$.
$n = 31$. $\sqrt{\left(\frac{1+kl+k'l'}{2}\right)} = 1 + \sqrt{(kl)} + \sqrt{(k'l')}$
$- (kl)^{\frac14} - (k'l')^{\frac14} - (klk'l')^{\frac14}$.
$n = 47$. $\sqrt{\left(\frac{1+kl+k'l'}{2}\right)} = \frac12\left\{1 + \sqrt{(kl)} + \sqrt{(k'l')}\right\}$
$+ \left(\frac{1}{16}klk'l'\right)^{\frac{1}{12}}\left\{1 + (kl)^{\frac14} + (k'l')^{\frac14}\right\}$.
$n = 71$. $\sqrt{\left(\frac{1+kl+k'l'}{2}\right)} = 1 + \sqrt{(kl)} + \sqrt{(k'l')}$
$- (kl)^{\frac14} - (k'l')^{\frac14} + (klk'l')^{\frac14}$
$+ (256klk'l')^{\frac{1}{12}}\left\{(kl)^{\frac14} + (k'l')^{\frac14} - 1\right\}$.
6. $n = 3$ $\begin{cases} M^2 = \frac{l}{k} + \frac{l'}{k'} - \frac{ll'}{kk'}. \\ \frac{9}{M^2} = \frac{k}{l} + \frac{k'}{l'} - \frac{kk'}{ll'}. \end{cases}$
$n = 5$. $\begin{cases} M = \sqrt{\left(\frac{l}{k}\right)} + \sqrt{\left(\frac{l'}{k'}\right)} - \sqrt{\left(\frac{ll'}{kk'}\right)}. \\ \frac{5}{M} = \sqrt{\left(\frac{k}{l}\right)} + \sqrt{\left(\frac{k'}{l'}\right)} - \sqrt{\left(\frac{kk'}{ll'}\right)} \end{cases}$
$n = 7$. $\begin{cases} M^2 = \frac{l}{k} + \frac{l'}{k'} - \frac{ll'}{kk'} - 8\left(\frac{ll'}{kk'}\right)^{\frac23} \\ \frac{49}{M^2} = \frac{k}{l} + \frac{k'}{l'} - \frac{kk'}{ll'} - 8\left(\frac{kk'}{ll'}\right)^{\frac23} \end{cases}$
$n = 9$. $\begin{cases} \sqrt{M} = \left(\frac{l}{k}\right)^{\frac14} + \left(\frac{l'}{k'}\right)^{\frac14} - \left(\frac{ll'}{kk'}\right)^{\frac14} \\ \frac{3}{\sqrt{M}} = \left(\frac{k}{l}\right)^{\frac14} + \left(\frac{k'}{l'}\right)^{\frac14} - \left(\frac{kk'}{ll'}\right)^{\frac14} \end{cases}$
